messages:
morgan: Hey team — seeing multiple customers (Okta + Azure IdP) with SCIM deprovision failures right after yesterday's RBAC rollout. Root says 403 from scim-provisioner and KMS decrypt errors in the logs. Anyone who owns the rbac change?

ashley: I rolled the RBAC patch at 2026-03-22T21:05Z (service:rbc-provisioner). It tightened the 'provisioner' role; I might've accidentally removed kms:Decrypt from the service principal. checking now.

devon: Confirmed 403s in recent traces: https://internal-console/redwood/logs?trace=TRACE12345 (only a pointer). Log snippet from scim-provisioner: 
```
2026-03-22T21:12:02Z ERROR scim-provisioner: deprovision failed tenant=acme-corp status=403
2026-03-22T21:12:02Z ERROR kms: Decrypt failed for key alias/arn "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd" error=AccessDeniedException
```

security-bot: Policy-change detected: rbac-service updated role "provisioner" at 2026-03-22T21:05Z by ashley. Changed permissions: removed ["kms:Decrypt"] for principal svc/scim-provisioner. Automated audit flagged this as high-risk for SCIM workflows.

neha: If KMS kms:Decrypt was removed, that would explain the decrypt errors. We need to check whether the key is customer-managed or platform-managed. Can someone run: `rcli kms describe --alias scim-prod` and `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>` to see grants.

sre-jamie: Agreed. Short mitigation options:
1) Temporarily re-add `kms:Decrypt` to the provisioner role (fast, but needs audit)
2) Create a one-off KMS grant to the service principal: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scim-provisioner --operations Decrypt --name "temp-scim-decrypt-grant"
```
3) Rollback the RBAC commit (if the change is risky).

oncall-elaine: I'm oncall, can push the temporary grant and do a staged backfill for the last hour of failures. Want me to proceed? I can also open an emergency deploy to revert the RBAC diff.

morgan: please proceed with the grant, elaine. Also we need to capture audit logs for compliance: forward the KMS CloudTrail entries + rbac-service change event to compliance@redwood.

ashley: On it — I can reapply the role change after we validate. For transparency: the intent was to limit KMS admin actions, not block decrypts for scim. My bad, missed the service principal exception.

devon: I ran `rcli kms describe --alias scim-prod` — key shows CustomerMasterKeyId: key/abcd, policy references allow Decrypt only to principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scim-provisioner if present. Current IAM role policy removed that statement.

neha: After the grant, we should also patch the rbac-service unit tests to assert scim-provisioner retains kms:Decrypt in all environments. Add a post-deploy smoke to run a fake deprovision call.

oncall-elaine: Grant created, backfill job kicked off for tenants affected between 21:00-21:30. Watching metrics. Will notify when jitter drops. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Noted: emergency grant created by oncall-elaine at 2026-03-22T22:05Z. Generated audit entry ID AUDIT-6789.

morgan: Good. Can we also triage whether any customer data was exposed or mis-deprovisioned because of the gap? Devon/neha — please run a quick delta check on successful deprovs vs intended for the window.

devon: Running a diff now against desired-state snapshots. Early look: ~12 tenants had queued deprovisions that errored and remain active. No successful unintended deprovision observed. Will post full list to the incident doc.

neha: I'll follow up with a vuln-triage note: classify this as PrivEsc misconfig -> medium severity, root cause = RBAC policy regression. Recommend: stricter PR checklist, require `rcli iam simulate` for KMS deps, and ephemeral test harness.

morgan: Thanks. Action items:
- ashley: open a roll-forward PR to re-add the exception + tests (owner).
- devon: finish tenant delta check and upload to incident doc (owner).
- neha: write vuln-triage summary and remediation plan (owner).
- elaine: monitor backfill and close grant after stabilization (owner).

ashley: PR opened -> https://git.redwood/rbac/commit/PR-452. Add a note for compliance.

oncall-elaine: Backfill completed, failures down to baseline. Tearing down temp grant in 30m unless objections.

morgan: no objections. Keep grant teardown in ticket and capture final audit log snapshot. We'll schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

sre-jamie: Also recommend adding a runtime exporter that counts KMS:AccessDenied for scim-provisioner and an alert on >5/min.

morgan: agreed. Thanks everyone. We'll document in ops/incidents and hand to compliance. :white_check_mark:
